title: Performance Investigation from User Impact to Evidence Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies performance investigation from user impact to evidence?
options: Define representative user impact and controlled evidence before changing the measured critical path.
Optimise the largest method by intuition
questions.answer: Define representative user impact and controlled evidence before changing the measured critical path.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A profiler hotspot proves optimising that method will improve the user’s end-to-end metric.
questions.explanation: Profiling a debuggable build with debugger and method instrumentation can create hotspots and jank that are not present in the optimised release path.

questions.prompt: What should every performance number include?
questions.answer: The exact journey, metric, device/environment, app/data state, compilation/build state and measurement method.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
